verdict: The updates handler reported that all updates in a batch failed to install. The batch-level error hides the per-update root cause.
fix: Drill into `UpdatesDeployment.log` on the client and find the per-update result codes. Typical patterns: insufficient disk space (`0x80070070`), pending reboot (`0x8024002D`), or dependency chain (`0x80240010`). Fix the per-update root cause; the batch-level 0x80240022 will clear on the next scan.
